chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Clarifying the move from Atlanta to Cincinnati
summary: JCH insists he went to Cincinnati for tailoring school and joined Helvey's band after arriving.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: You went to Cincinnati with Wes Helvey's band, from Atlanta?
No, I didn't go there with his band. I joined his band when I was there.
So when you left Atlanta you went to Cincinnati to join Wes Helvey's band?
O.K., now I'll straighten you out again. I went to Cincinnati; I went to school there, for tailoring and while I was there I joined Wes Helvey's band. Understand? Straight?
I think I am now. You got that, Donald?
Wes Helvey's band was in Cincinnati, not in Atlanta? Was Cincinnati the first time that you had left Atlanta?
